reference_spoken: Psalm one hundred twenty-seven, verse one.
verse: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verse_spoken: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it:
except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
prayer: Heavenly Father, this morning I bring my family before you.
You know every name, every need, and every burden in my home.
Be the builder of our house, and let your love be its foundation.
Where there is tension, bring patience; where there is hurt, bring healing.
Teach us to speak kindly, listen well, and forgive quickly.
Keep watch over the ones I love, near and far, and guard them from harm.
Draw back to you anyone in my family who has drifted away.
Fill our home with peace, laughter, and gratitude for one another.
Let every family praying with me feel your presence and protection today.
